steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: Cough cough... Is this thing on? Ugh... Huff... Okay... I'll try anyway...

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: Brock... it's me. We ran out of time. And vehicles. We cleared out the underground lab in Nirvana Port, and many people made it there. Hopefully, it'll protect them from the heat. Those guns you captured... they're important, right? I'm going to try and hide them before it's too late.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: Just in case I don't make it back... there's something I need to say.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: I hate war, and I've sworn never to take part in it. I'm a scientist. I wanted to help people through my research, not make weapons to kill. Not see my work turned into... blood. Every night, I see it. I can't escape it.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: That's why I left you. I thought I could stay away from all this. But then I'd hear about our people suffering, see those smug faces from the metropoles... and I'd get so angry. So helpless. Part of me always wanted to run right back to you. To fight.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: And now... many others will too. Hands used to work and farm will transport weapons for you. Those who heal lives will run into crossfire to save wounded fighters. We'll help, whatever the cost. However they retaliate.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: We're not soldiers... but we can't just do nothing. It's in our blood, Brock. Yours and ours. This city... it's in us. We can't just watch it burn.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: So promise me something. Just this one thing.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: Keep their hands clean. The civilians, the volunteers—the people who still remember what peace feels like. However righteous the fight is... don't let killing become normal to them. Once you cross that line... you'll never come all the way back.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: If you have to stay on this battlefield, then keep their hands clean. The people who believe in you—let them go home when this is over. Let them still remember how to live. You've already got blood on your hand. So you carry the weight. That's your duty as a soldier. Walk through the hell, so they don't have to.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: As for me... I'll be waiting for you. On the other side.

steps.speaker: Helena
steps.content: ...But take your time, alright? Win this war. Live a long life. Grow old in a free DisCity... and then come tell me all about it.

The tape ended with a soft click. The clouds had parted, spilling moonlight across a sea of white sand. He lifted his head, dazed, and his eyes found the familiar silhouette of Nirvana Port in the distance—a view he had gazed upon countless times from this very spot.
Now, he stared only at the massive wreckage that buried his beloved. She had gone to hell ahead of him, just as she'd said she would.
